description:
Your Impact

The Principal Machine Learning Research Scientist helps lead and shape the strategic direction of DISCO’s machine learning and AI research initiatives. They are a seasoned researcher with a proven track record in impactful research, innovation, and leadership. They drive the development of advanced algorithms, optimize research processes, and collaborate across teams to have a meaningful impact on industry challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Research Leadership and Innovation: Leads impactful machine learning research projects. Drives innovation in algorithm development and methodologies. Provides strategic direction for the organization's research agenda.
  • Operational Excellence and Program Management: Optimizes research processes, workflows, and resource allocation. Manages large-scale research programs and oversees multiple projects and teams. Ensures the successful execution of complex research initiatives.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Industry Impact: Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners. Engages with industry stakeholders to understand and address real-world challenges. Drives the application of machine learning solutions to have a meaningful impact on industry.
  • Strategic Planning and Contribution to Research Community: Develops and executes strategic plans for the organization's research initiatives. Contributes to the development and implementation of long-term research strategies. Actively participates in the broader research community.
  • Mentorship and Team Development: Mentors and provides guidance to junior and mid-level researchers. Leads and manages research teams, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing and innovation. Contributes to the professional development of team members.

Who You Are

  • 12 to 15+ years of relevant experience in machine learning research.
  • Proven track record of impactful research and leadership in large-scale projects.
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving innovative machine learning research.
  • Proven ability to lead and guide research teams toward groundbreaking contributions and advancements.
  • Expertise in developing and executing strategic plans for an organization's overarching machine learning research agenda.
  • Leadership in fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing and innovation within the research team.
  • Recognition for external contributions to the broader machine learning research community
  • Thought leadership demonstrated through publications, keynote presentations, or participation in industry conferences.
  • Proven track record of making a significant impact by applying machine learning research to real-world industry problems.
  • Strong collaboration skills, including effective engagement with industry partners and stakeholders.

Even Better If You Have…

  • Operational leadership in optimizing research processes.
  • Extensive experience in program management and overseeing multifaceted initiatives.

 

Authorization to Work in the U.S.: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future. DISCO is not currently sponsoring visas, including, but not limited to, H-1B, TN, or EAD, and we are not accepting visa transfers.

Perks of DISCO 

  • Open, inclusive, and fun environment
  • Benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, as well as 401(k) 
  • Competitive salary plus RSUs
  • Flexible PTO 
  • Opportunity to be a part of a company that is revolutionizing the legal industry
  • Growth opportunities throughout the company

About DISCO

DISCO provides a cloud-native, artificial intelligence-powered legal solution that simplifies ediscovery, legal document review and case management for enterprises, law firms, legal services providers and governments. Our scalable, integrated solution enables legal departments to easily collect, process and review enterprise data that is relevant or potentially relevant to legal matters. 

At DISCO, we believe AI is a core enabler of how work gets done. All employees are expected to proactively adopt and responsibly use AI tools to drive efficiency, improve outcomes, and continuously evolve how they operate in their role.

Are you ready to help us fulfill our mission to use technology to strengthen the rule of law? Join us! 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
